title.en: Is It Alive? Characteristics of Life
title.zh: 它是活的吗？生物的特征

clips.send: Brick-like boxes in neat rows: cells! Each box has a cell wall. The insides are hard to see without a stain.
clips.text: Brick-like boxes in neat rows: cells! Each box has a cell wall. The insides are hard to see without a stain.

clips.send: The flat face of a crystal. No walls, no nucleus.
clips.text: The flat face of a crystal. No walls, no nucleus.

clips.send: Suspect one, the fire. It eats fuel, uses oxygen, gives off heat, grows, and even spreads to start new flames. Suspicious!
clips.text: Suspect one, the fire. It eats fuel, uses oxygen, gives off heat, grows, and even spreads to start new flames. Suspicious!

clips.send: A drop of salt water with a few tiny clear cubes.
clips.text: A drop of salt water with a few tiny clear cubes.

clips.send: A mushroom on a rotting log. It popped up overnight after a rainstorm. It has no leaves and isn’t green.
clips.text: A mushroom on a rotting log. It popped up overnight after a rainstorm. It has no leaves and isn’t green.

clips.send: The hardest case: a virus. It has genes and it evolves, but it has no cells and can only copy itself inside a living cell. Scientists still argue; most say it is not alive on its own.
clips.text: The hardest case: a virus. It has genes and it evolves, but it has no cells and can only copy itself inside a living cell. Scientists still argue; most say it is not alive on its own.

clips.send: Suspect three, a drop of pond water. Under the microscope: a paramecium! It is a whole living thing made of just one cell.
clips.text: Suspect three, a drop of pond water. Under the microscope: a paramecium! It is a whole living thing made of just one cell.

clips.send: A campfire. It “eats” wood, “breathes” oxygen, gives off heat, grows bigger and its sparks start new fires.
clips.text: A campfire. It “eats” wood, “breathes” oxygen, gives off heat, grows bigger and its sparks start new fires.

clips.send: Clear, cube-shaped crystals with straight edges.
clips.text: Clear, cube-shaped crystals with straight edges.

clips.send: A wooden table. Look closely at the wood and you can see rings and a grain. Under a microscope: tiny boxes.
clips.text: A wooden table. Look closely at the wood and you can see rings and a grain. Under a microscope: tiny boxes.

clips.send: Oval yeast cells! Some have a small bump on one side: a bud.
clips.text: Oval yeast cells! Some have a small bump on one side: a bud.

clips.send: A fire grows, uses oxygen and spreads. Explain why fire is still NOT alive.
clips.text: A fire grows, uses oxygen and spreads. Explain why fire is still NOT alive.

clips.send: One cell fills the view. The tiny dots and rods near it are bacteria that live in your mouth!
clips.text: One cell fills the view. The tiny dots and rods near it are bacteria that live in your mouth!

clips.send: A rose cut and put in a vase. It still drinks water and its bud slowly opens, but it has no roots anymore.
clips.text: A rose cut and put in a vase. It still drinks water and its bud slowly opens, but it has no roots anymore.

clips.send: A robot dog with an AI brain. It runs on a battery, wags its tail when you pet it, answers questions and “learns” your voice.
clips.text: A robot dog with an AI brain. It runs on a battery, wags its tail when you pet it, answers questions and “learns” your voice.

clips.send: The rule: a living thing shows ALL the characteristics, not just one. Made of cells, uses energy, grows, reproduces, responds, stays balanced, has DNA and adapts.
clips.text: The rule: a living thing shows ALL the characteristics, not just one. Made of cells, uses energy, grows, reproduces, responds, stays balanced, has DNA and adapts.

clips.send: A dry bean seed in a packet. It has been in a kitchen drawer for 5 years. It doesn’t move, eat or grow.
clips.text: A dry bean seed in a packet. It has been in a kitchen drawer for 5 years. It doesn’t move, eat or grow.

clips.send: Slipper-shaped paramecia swim past green strands of algae. Each paramecium is ONE cell.
clips.text: Slipper-shaped paramecia swim past green strands of algae. Each paramecium is ONE cell.

clips.send: It swims with tiny hairs called cilia, eats bacteria, and pumps out extra water to stay balanced. When salt drifts close, it backs away. It responds!
clips.text: It swims with tiny hairs called cilia, eats bacteria, and pumps out extra water to stay balanced. When salt drifts close, it backs away. It responds!

clips.send: Case file: is it alive? Our three suspects are a campfire, a dry bean seed and one drop of pond water.
clips.text: Case file: is it alive? Our three suspects are a campfire, a dry bean seed and one drop of pond water.

clips.send: In the “A Closer Look at Life” lab, what evidence would show that something in a pond-water sample is alive?
clips.text: In the “A Closer Look at Life” lab, what evidence would show that something in a pond-water sample is alive?

clips.send: A flu virus. It makes you sick, spreads from person to person and changes every year, so you need a new flu shot.
clips.text: A flu virus. It makes you sick, spreads from person to person and changes every year, so you need a new flu shot.

clips.send: A honeycomb of tiny empty boxes: cells! Robert Hooke saw exactly this in 1665.
clips.text: A honeycomb of tiny empty boxes: cells! Robert Hooke saw exactly this in 1665.

clips.send: A computer virus. It copies itself, spreads from computer to computer and some versions even change their code.
clips.text: A computer virus. It copies itself, spreads from computer to computer and some versions even change their code.

clips.send: Thick brown walls with nothing inside at all.
clips.text: Thick brown walls with nothing inside at all.

clips.send: Just the surface of a mineral. Nothing repeats like cells do.
clips.text: Just the surface of a mineral. Nothing repeats like cells do.

clips.send: So close you see only part of it: cilia beat like oars, and a star-shaped contractile vacuole pumps out extra water (homeostasis!).
clips.text: So close you see only part of it: cilia beat like oars, and a star-shaped contractile vacuole pumps out extra water (homeostasis!).

clips.send: But zoom in: fire has no cells and no DNA. It is a chemical reaction. It can’t keep its inside stable, and new flames inherit nothing. Fire is NOT alive.
clips.text: But zoom in: fire has no cells and no DNA. It is a chemical reaction. It can’t keep its inside stable, and new flames inherit nothing. Fire is NOT alive.

clips.send: You added a drop of salt water on the left. The paramecia turn and swim AWAY from it: a response to a stimulus!
clips.text: You added a drop of salt water on the left. The paramecia turn and swim AWAY from it: a response to a stimulus!

clips.send: Is a virus alive? Pick a side and support it with at least two characteristics.
clips.text: Is a virus alive? Pick a side and support it with at least two characteristics.

clips.send: A dried-out tardigrade (water bear). This half-millimeter animal has been bone dry for 10 years, curled into a tiny barrel.
clips.text: A dried-out tardigrade (water bear). This half-millimeter animal has been bone dry for 10 years, curled into a tiny barrel.

clips.send: Salt crystals growing in a jar. Every day the cubes get bigger, and new little cubes appear next to them.
clips.text: Salt crystals growing in a jar. Every day the cubes get bigger, and new little cubes appear next to them.

clips.send: Angular, glassy grains, mostly quartz. No walls, no nucleus.
clips.text: Angular, glassy grains, mostly quartz. No walls, no nucleus.

clips.send: A human skin cell in a lab dish. Scientists keep it in a warm dish of nutrient liquid. Over a few days it divides again and again.
clips.text: A human skin cell in a lab dish. Scientists keep it in a warm dish of nutrient liquid. Over a few days it divides again and again.

clips.send: Tiny, flat, faint shapes. Zoom in more.
clips.text: Tiny, flat, faint shapes. Zoom in more.

clips.send: A nucleus taken out of a cell. Scientists can pull the nucleus out of a cell. It is full of DNA.
clips.text: A nucleus taken out of a cell. Scientists can pull the nucleus out of a cell. It is full of DNA.

clips.send: One hour later: a paramecium pinched in the middle and split in two (reproduction!), and the food vacuoles are full of green algae it ate (energy).
clips.text: One hour later: a paramecium pinched in the middle and split in two (reproduction!), and the food vacuoles are full of green algae it ate (energy).

clips.send: Wait an hour and it splits in two. Both new cells carry a copy of its DNA. That is reproduction. Verdict: ALIVE!
clips.text: Wait an hour and it splits in two. Both new cells carry a copy of its DNA. That is reproduction. Verdict: ALIVE!

clips.send: Yeast in bread dough. A spoonful of tan powder goes into warm dough. An hour later the dough has doubled in size.
clips.text: Yeast in bread dough. A spoonful of tan powder goes into warm dough. An hour later the dough has doubled in size.

clips.send: A haze of tiny dots. Maybe cells, but too small to tell. Zoom in.
clips.text: A haze of tiny dots. Maybe cells, but too small to tell. Zoom in.

clips.send: Suspect two, the bean seed. It has sat in a packet for years, doing nothing. Dead? Cut it open: inside is a tiny baby plant made of living cells, packed with food.
clips.text: Suspect two, the bean seed. It has sat in a packet for years, doing nothing. Dead? Cut it open: inside is a tiny baby plant made of living cells, packed with food.

clips.send: A crystal up close: straight edges and square corners. No cells.
clips.text: A crystal up close: straight edges and square corners. No cells.

clips.send: Add water and warmth, a stimulus, and the seed wakes up. It respires, grows and develops into a plant. Alive, just dormant!
clips.text: Add water and warmth, a stimulus, and the seed wakes up. It respires, grows and develops into a plant. Alive, just dormant!

clips.send: You are looking at part of one cell: a thin wall and almost clear cytoplasm.
clips.text: You are looking at part of one cell: a thin wall and almost clear cytoplasm.

clips.send: A mule (it can’t have babies). A mule’s mother is a horse and its father is a donkey. Almost all mules can’t reproduce.
clips.text: A mule (it can’t have babies). A mule’s mother is a horse and its father is a donkey. Almost all mules can’t reproduce.

clips.send: A paramecium from pond water. A tiny slipper-shaped thing zooms around a drop of pond water under the microscope.
clips.text: A paramecium from pond water. A tiny slipper-shaped thing zooms around a drop of pond water under the microscope.

clips.send: The stain slows them down and shows a big dark nucleus in each paramecium.
clips.text: The stain slows them down and shows a big dark nucleus in each paramecium.

clips.send: One of your red blood cells. It carries oxygen for about 120 days. It has no nucleus and can’t divide.
clips.text: One of your red blood cells. It carries oxygen for about 120 days. It has no nucleus and can’t divide.

clips.send: 一只晒干的水熊虫。这只半毫米长的小动物已经干透了 10 年，蜷成了一个小桶的形状。
clips.text: 一只晒干的水熊虫. 这只半毫米长的小动物已经干透了 10 年，蜷成了一个小桶的形状。

clips.send: 一排排整齐的“砖块”：细胞！每一格都有细胞壁。不染色的话，里面的东西很难看清。
clips.text: 一排排整齐的“砖块”：细胞！每一格都有细胞壁。不染色的话，里面的东西很难看清。

clips.send: 最难的案子：病毒。它有基因，也会进化，但它没有细胞，只能在活细胞里复制自己。科学家至今仍有争论，大多数人认为它单独存在时不是活的。
clips.text: 最难的案子：病毒。它有基因，也会进化，但它没有细胞，只能在活细胞里复制自己。科学家至今仍有争论，大多数人认为它单独存在时不是活的。

clips.send: 你的一个红细胞。它运送氧气大约 120 天。它没有细胞核，也不能分裂。
clips.text: 你的一个红细胞. 它运送氧气大约 120 天。它没有细胞核，也不能分裂。

clips.send: 剪下来插在花瓶里的玫瑰。它还在吸水，花苞也在慢慢开放，但它已经没有根了。
clips.text: 剪下来插在花瓶里的玫瑰. 它还在吸水，花苞也在慢慢开放，但它已经没有根了。

clips.send: 火会变大、消耗氧气，还会蔓延。请解释为什么火仍然不是生物。
clips.text: 火会变大、消耗氧气，还会蔓延。请解释为什么火仍然不是生物。

clips.send: 近得只能看到它的一部分：纤毛像船桨一样划动，星形的伸缩泡把多余的水排出去（这就是稳态！）。
clips.text: 近得只能看到它的一部分：纤毛像船桨一样划动，星形的伸缩泡把多余的水排出去（这就是稳态！）。

clips.send: 小小的、扁平的、淡淡的形状。再放大一些。
clips.text: 小小的、扁平的、淡淡的形状。再放大一些。

clips.send: 一滴盐水，里面有几颗小小的透明立方体。
clips.text: 一滴盐水，里面有几颗小小的透明立方体。

clips.send: 有棱有角、像玻璃一样的颗粒，大多是石英。没有细胞壁，也没有细胞核。
clips.text: 有棱有角、像玻璃一样的颗粒，大多是石英shíyīng。没有细胞壁，也没有细胞核。

clips.send: 它用叫“纤毛”的细毛游动，吃细菌，把多余的水排出去以保持平衡。盐飘过来时，它会退开。它会作出反应！
clips.text: 它用叫“纤毛”的细毛游动，吃细菌，把多余的水排出去以保持平衡。盐飘过来时，它会退开。它会作出反应！

clips.send: 像拖鞋一样的草履虫从绿色的丝状藻旁边游过。每只草履虫只有“一个”细胞。
clips.text: 像拖鞋一样的草履虫从绿色的丝状藻旁边游过。每只草履虫只有“一个”细胞。

clips.send: 等一小时，它一分为二。两个新细胞都带着一份它的 DNA。这就是繁殖。结论：活的！
clips.text: 等一小时，它一分为二。两个新细胞都带着一份它的 DNA。这就是繁殖。结论：活的！

clips.send: 案件档案：它是活的吗？三个嫌疑人：一堆篝火、一粒干豆子和一滴池塘水。
clips.text: 案件档案：它是活的吗？三个嫌疑人：一堆篝火、一粒干豆子和一滴池塘水。

clips.send: 嫌疑人一：火。它“吃”燃料、消耗氧气、放出热量、越烧越大，还会蔓延点燃新的火苗。很可疑！
clips.text: 嫌疑人一：火。它“吃”燃料、消耗氧气、放出热量、越烧越大，还会蔓延点燃新的火苗。很可疑！

clips.send: 像蜂窝一样的小空格：细胞！罗伯特·胡克 1665 年看到的正是这样。
clips.text: 像蜂窝一样的小空格：细胞！罗伯特·胡克 1665 年看到的正是这样。

clips.send: 一张木头桌子。仔细看木头，能看到年轮和纹理。在显微镜下：一个个小格子。
clips.text: 一张木头桌子. 仔细看木头，能看到年轮和纹理。在显微镜下：一个个小格子。

clips.send: 像拖鞋一样的草履虫从绿色的丝状藻旁边游过。每只草履虫只有“一个”细胞。
clips.text: 像拖鞋一样的草履虫cǎolǚchóng从绿色的丝状藻zǎo旁边游过。每只草履虫只有“一个”细胞。

clips.send: 但是放大看：火没有细胞，也没有 DNA，它只是一种化学反应。它不能保持内部稳定，新火苗也没有遗传任何东西。火不是活的！
clips.text: 但是放大看：火没有细胞，也没有 DNA，它只是一种化学反应。它不能保持内部稳定，新火苗也没有遗传任何东西。火不是活的！

clips.send: 烂木头上的蘑菇。一场雨后，它一夜之间冒了出来。它没有叶子，也不是绿色的。

clips.send: 椭圆形的酵母细胞！有些细胞的一侧长着一个小鼓包：芽体。
clips.text: 椭圆tuǒyuán形的酵母jiàomǔ细胞！有些细胞的一侧长着一个小鼓包：芽体。

clips.send: 罐子里正在长大的盐晶体。这些立方体一天比一天大，旁边还冒出了新的小立方体。
clips.text: 罐子里正在长大的盐晶体. 这些立方体一天比一天大，旁边还冒出了新的小立方体。

clips.send: 染色让它们慢了下来，每只草履虫里都显出了一个深色的大细胞核。

clips.send: 1 小时后：一只草履虫从中间缢裂，一分为二（繁殖！）；食物泡里装满了它吃下的绿藻（利用能量）。

clips.send: 嫌疑人三：一滴池塘水。显微镜下：一只草履虫！它是只由一个细胞构成的完整生物。

clips.send: 流感病毒。它让人生病，在人与人之间传播，而且每年都会变，所以每年都要打新的流感疫苗。

clips.send: 装着人工智能大脑的机器狗。它用电池驱动，你摸它时它会摇尾巴，能回答问题，还能“学会”认出你的声音。
clips.text: 装着人工智能大脑的机器狗. 它用电池驱动，你摸它时它会摇尾巴，能回答问题，还能“学会”认出你的声音。

clips.send: 加水、加温，给它一个刺激，种子就醒了。它进行呼吸、生长发育，长成一株植物。它是活的，只是在休眠！

clips.send: 病毒是活的吗？选择一方，并用至少两条特征来支持你的观点。

clips.send: 袋子里的一粒干豆子。它在厨房抽屉里放了 5 年，不动、不吃，也不长。

clips.send: 一片朦胧的小点点。也许是细胞，但太小了看不清。再放大。

clips.send: 嫌疑人二：豆子。它在袋子里躺了好几年，什么也不做。死了吗？切开看：里面有一株由活细胞构成的小小胚，还储存着营养。

clips.send: 面团里的酵母。一勺浅褐色的粉末放进温暖的面团里，一小时后面团胀大了一倍。

clips.send: 规则：生物要具备“全部”特征，而不只是一条。由细胞构成、利用能量、生长、繁殖、作出反应、保持稳态、有 DNA、能适应进化。
